uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with five or more +1/+1 counters on it

2893-4762-5455-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4762-5455-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Bristly Bill and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 four additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4762-5455-8289.notes:
Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.
If Devoted Druid has six or more +1/+1 counters when you begin the combo, it will also get infinite +1/+1 counters which can be removed for infinite green mana.

765-2645-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2645-3430-4644.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

512-2872-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-2872-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4419-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

728-3175-7424.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-3375-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3375-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4826-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

301-5663-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

957-5144-7874.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking The Immortal Weapons and exiling Ephemerate.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4499-5645-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1261-6717.description:
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tezzeret's first ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, untapping Time Vault.
Repeat each turn.

2829-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2829-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-5147-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-465-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-6797-6972--112.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
3773-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1818-2173-5010-6798.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1400-2034-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-2034-4619.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding  {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Repeat.

328-2173-3967-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-3967-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

826-3767-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
826-3767-3918-4306.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3330-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3330-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1339-2122-3129-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-3129-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3204-3480-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-3480-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2018-3967-6288.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

509-1267-2750-4883.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-2750-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2750-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

38-2316-4094.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2366-3346-4147-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
"Mercenary" chosen with Conspiracy.
1636-2366-3346-4147-4875.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1987-2493-3836-5002.notablePrerequisites:
Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
You control a basic Island.
1987-2493-3836-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing instant spells you cast this turn to cost {2} less and causing you to gain two life.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer and a basic Island.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

176-560-2034.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Repeat.

914-2047.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments; additional permanents beyond this minimum can reduce the mana needed.
914-2047.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U} while keeping at least seven Treasures on the battlefield, attaching it to a Treasure you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

2367-2557-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

1699-1802-2060-4120.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature without flying.
1699-1802-2060-4120.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, causing all damage that would be dealt this turn to you or to permanents you control to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Scourge of Kher Ridges's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 2 damage to each creature without flying.
Gideon's Sacrifice redirects damage to Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least twice by removing at least two +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4449-4474-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Hateflayer.
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
4449-4474-4893.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
